findings.source_passage: I would have you, as a sensible physiologist, simply—particularly remark its front aspect, in all its compacted collectedness.
findings.why_it_matters: The rhetorical address 'I would have you' repeated with 'simply—particularly' and 'I would have you investigate it now' is the voice-establishing didactic mode of the chapter; collapsing it to 'Regard now' flattens the narrator's insistent, professorial tone.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'I would have you, as a sensible physiologist, simply—particularly remark its front aspect' and the second 'I would have you investigate it now with the sole view of forming to yourself some unexaggerated, intelligent estimate.'

findings.source_passage: you observe that… you observe that… you observe that… Wherefore, you must now have perceived
findings.why_it_matters: The repeated 'you observe that' anaphora is the rhetorical engine of the paragraph and a stylistically distinctive Melvillean gesture; the draft strips all five instances into a bare list, killing the prosodic and ironic texture.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least three 'you observe that' clauses to preserve the anaphoric rhythm that is the signature of this passage.

findings.source_passage: the blubber wraps the body of the whale, as the rind wraps an orange. Just so with the head; but with this difference
findings.why_it_matters: The orange-rind simile is a memorable, concretizing analogy Melville planted here deliberately and cross-referenced ('In some previous place I have described…'); its removal erases both a distinctive image and the narrator's self-referential voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'the blubber wraps the body of the whale, as the rind wraps an orange. Just so with the head; but with this difference…'

findings.source_passage: By itself this sufficiently illustrates the obvious fact I drive at.
findings.why_it_matters: This self-conscious, mock-pedantic aside ('the obvious fact I drive at') is characteristic of Ishmael's rhetorical self-commentary and is dropped without replacement.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert the phrase after the Indiamen analogy to preserve the narrator's metalinguistic voice.

summary: Three medium-severity findings (anaphora erasure, orange-rind simile loss, opening address flattening) and one low finding; no single high-severity loss, so the draft passes but should be revised to restore the 'you observe' anaphora and the orange-rind simile.
